ABK supplies genuine products to detailing studios, workshops, commercial carwashes, dealerships, and retail DIY car owners. ABK is not a workshop. The one installed service ABK sells is VTEK paint protection film for car owners in Qatar: ABK quotes, books and guarantees the job, and the film is fitted at a VTEK-authorised partner centre in Doha (https://abktradingservice.com/en/b2c/ppf-installation — from QAR 899 front-end, QAR 1,599 full front, QAR 3,999 full body). ABK does not perform window tinting, ceramic coating application or detailing services.

## 1. Brand Portfolio & Distributorship Rights

### VTEK (formerly Vertek) — Paint Protection & Window Films
- **Origin:** United States (Manufactured to high-performance GCC climate specifications)
- **Product Range:** Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU) Paint Protection Films (PPF) and Nano-Ceramic Solar Heat Rejection Window Tint Films.
- **Key Characteristics:** Polycarbonate-infused TPU, instant self-healing topcoat (activated by ambient heat or hot water), optical clarity, non-yellowing aliphatic resins, manufacturer warranties up to 15 years.
- **Target Channels:** Detailing studios, tint shops, luxury vehicle dealerships, and individual car owners seeking premium surface protection.

### Autotriz Nano Ceramic Coatings & Polishing Systems
- **Origin:** Germany / International
- **Product Range:** Professional-grade nano ceramic coatings (V-9 3D Matrix 9H, Matrix Hybrid), specialised interior ceramic coatings (Leather, Vinyl, Textile), automotive compounds (Heavy Cut 901, Power Cut 701, Ultimate Polish 302, One Step Finish), and commercial wash chemicals (Rich Foam Shampoo 20L).
- **Target Channels:** Professional detailing studios, body shops, commercial car washes, and certified coating applicators.

### Briller Car Care
- **Origin:** Canada
- **Product Range:** Automotive wash chemicals, detailing sprays, tyre dressings, and surface cleaners formulated for harsh weather conditions.
- **Key Products:** Car Shampoo Wash & Wax, Tyre Foam, Tyre Shine, Crystal Clear Glass Cleaner, Multi-Purpose Cleaner (MPC).

### Grizzly & GrünesAuto
- **Product Range:** Heavy-duty car care chemicals, 6-inch German-engineered foam polishing pads (Heavy Cut, Medium Cut, Finishing), plush microfiber towels (400–1200 GSM), and wash accessories.

### ABK Proprietary Products
- **ABK Rejuvenate Plastic Restorer:** Made in France. Multi-surface exterior trim restorer restoring deep black finish to faded, sun-damaged bumpers, trims, and mirrors with 6+ months durability.
- **ABK Home & Car Fragrance Line:** Mashmom and Secret concentrated luxury scents formulated for Gulf luxury interiors.

### Category 1: Paint Protection Films (PPF)

- **SKU:** `vtek-ppf-weather-armor-ultimate`

- **Topcoat:** Instant heat-activated self-healing clearcoat; hydrophobic water-contact angle > 105°
- **Warranty:** 15-Year Manufacturer Warranty against yellowing, cracking, bubbling, and delamination.
- **Roll Dimension:** 1.52m × 15m (60 inches × 49.2 feet)
- **Applications:** Full-body vehicle wraps, high-impact front clips, rocker panels, mirrors.

## 3. Qatar Climate Adaptation & Detailing Challenges

Every chemical and film distributed by ABK is selected specifically to withstand the extreme environmental conditions of the Arabian Gulf:
1. **Extreme Ambient Heat (45°C–50°C+):** Cheap PVC/TPH films turn brittle and melt adhesive into factory paint. VTEK aliphatic TPU withstands prolonged panel temperatures exceeding 80°C.
2. **Desert Sandstorm Abrasion:** Sand micro-particles act as an abrasive grit at highway speeds (120 km/h). VTEK self-healing top-coats absorb micro-swirls, self-repairing under sunlight.
3. **Hard Tap Water & Mineral Etching:** Doha desalinated tap water contains high concentrations of dissolved minerals (calcium/magnesium). Autotriz ceramic coatings provide hydrophobic contact angles (>110°), forcing water to slide off before droplets can bake into mineral rings.
4. **Intense Solar UV Radiation:** High UV index causes clearcoat yellowing and interior leather shrinkage. VTEK and Autotriz incorporate advanced UV stabilizers.

- **Target B2B Accounts:** Automotive Detailing Studios, Window Tinting Shops, Commercial Car Washes, Dealership Service Centers, Commercial Fleets, and Car Rental Companies across Qatar and the GCC.
- **Minimum Order Quantities (MOQ):**
  - PPF & Window Tint: Single master rolls (1.52m × 15m or 1.52m × 30m) eligible for tiered volume discounts.
  - Car Care Chemicals: Master cartons (12 or 24 units per box).
  - Bulk Shampoos & Degreasers: 20-Litre drums.
- **Trade Account Benefits:** Dedicated account manager, wholesale pricing tiers, free local delivery across Doha for qualified orders, marketing support, and product application training.
- **How to Apply:** Visit https://abktradingservice.com/en/b2b/become-a-dealer or message the Wholesale Trade Desk directly on WhatsApp at +974 3083 8355.

## 5. Installed PPF Service for Car Owners in Qatar

ABK sells installed VTEK paint protection film. ABK quotes, books, takes payment and stands behind the job; a VTEK-authorised installer at a partner centre in Doha does the fitting. ABK supplies the film from its own stock as the authorised VTEK distributor in Qatar.

### Installed prices (QAR, updated 4 October 2026)

| Coverage | Film | Sedan / Coupe | SUV / Crossover | Large SUV / Pickup |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front-end kit | PRO | 899 | 1,049 | 1,199 |
| Front-end kit | PRO PLUS or MATTE | 1,099 | 1,249 | 1,399 |
| Full front | PRO | 1,599 | 1,899 | 2,199 |
| Full front | PRO PLUS or MATTE | 1,899 | 2,299 | 2,599 |
| Full body | PRO | 3,999 | 4,799 | 5,499 |
| Full body | PRO PLUS or MATTE | 4,799 | 5,699 | 6,499 |

- **Front-end kit:** front bumper, the leading ~40 cm of the bonnet and fenders, mirrors, headlights.
- **Full front:** whole bonnet, front bumper, both front fenders, mirrors, headlights.
- **Full body:** every painted panel.
- **Individual panels:** live estimate in the quote builder, from QAR 500, capped at the full-body price; confirmed on WhatsApp.
- **PRISM colour PPF:** priced per car (enquire on WhatsApp). **Old film or wrap removal:** added to the confirmed price.

### What every installation includes (verification steps)
1. Genuine VTEK film from the authorised Qatar distributor (never sourced from a third party).
2. Fitting by a VTEK-authorised installer in Doha.
3. Condition photos at drop-off; pre-existing paint defects recorded.
4. ABK inspection of the finish before handover.
5. VTEK manufacturer warranty registered to the car: PRO 10 years, PRO PLUS 12 years, MATTE 5 years, PRISM 5 years (against yellowing, cracking, delamination).
6. ABK workmanship cover for 12 months (lifting, bubbles, edge failure).

### Booking terms
- Typical fitting time: front-end same day; full front 1 day; full body 2–3 days.
- Payment: 100% by bank transfer or cash after ABK confirms the slot.
- Cancellation: full refund up to 48 hours before the slot; one free reschedule.
